page.overview:
Who is Cake's babies?

Cake's babies are five fictional children of Cake and M-Cron. They are a gender-swapped version of Jake and Lady Rainicorn's offspring.

The babies were born in Cake's dream that resembled an episode of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cheers Cheers]. In a hospital made ouf of cardboard, Cake expressed worry that her and M-Cron's babies would turn out "all mixed-up like her," while being comforted by M-Cron. Then, the dream version of [https://cheers.fandom.com/wiki/Cliff_Clavin Cliff Clavin] brought in a basket of five newborn kittens. Cake, after realizing that her babies are as unusual as her, dropped the basket on accident, scattering the kittens around the room. She then tried to pick them up in panic but was stopped by Fionna and Huntress Wizard who were chasing the Cosmic Owl. They then took her to a different dream, leaving M-Cron alone with their offspring and the human version of Ms. Cupcake.

Cake gave birth to five babies who appear to be the kitten version of Jake and Lady's Pups. The kitten version of Charlie has yellow fur and six freckles on its cheeks. The counterpart of T.V. is a round kitten with gray fur. The counterpart of Viola is a kitten with a more orangish fur, a slightly longer neck and a flower on its head. The kitten version of Kim Kil Whan has reddish-orange fur and an exceptionally long neck. Jake Jr.'s counterpart has white fur and a face consisting only of several small lumps. The babies are quite small and are able to fit in a basket together.
